Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Lift Tube Escape]]: the floor-by-floor "Store Directory" in an advertisement for Holden & Stone, a department store at 65 North Street, Pittsfield, Massachusetts. It lists what is sold on each floor, starting "First floor, front: Umbrellas, Ladies' Neckwear, Leather Goods", with carpets, rugs and draperies further down. Cropped from the advertisement page, page 555.

Source: ''Pittsfield Directory'' for 1907, Internet Archive item [https://archive.org/details/pittsfield-ma-directory-collection pittsfield-ma-directory-collection] (Pittsfield + Berkshire County MA Directory Collection), file Pittsfield_MA_Directory_1907_jp2.zip, page image Pittsfield_MA_Directory_1907_0514.jp2. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/pittsfield-ma-directory-collection Internet Archive] (SHA-256 of the page image: 3e9825fc4d397a5080bf04969f83aaebcdb1299eac3a4e34d46c4e6eaacbbb5e).
